View available times
Already booked and have a practical question? Use the contact details in your confirmation email.
HATA Studio is based in the Netherlands; you will receive the visit address with your appointment.
Privacy policy
This website does not use contact forms, analytics or advertising trackers. Our web server keeps standard technical logs, such as an IP address and visit time, for security.

When you make an appointment through Aimy or contact HATA Studio by email, HATA Studio and the relevant service providers use your details only to answer you and organise your appointment. Aimy processes booking details under its own privacy policy.
Under the GDPR you have the right to access, correct and delete your personal data. Contact HATA Studio to exercise these rights.
Cookie notice
This site uses only functional cookies needed for it to work, such as remembering your chosen language. We do not use analytics or advertising cookies, so there is no cookie banner to accept.
